binosmovement.configuration.title: Bino's Vanilla+ Movement
binosmovement.configuration.headCamera.t: In first person the camera moves with the animations (flips spin the view, thrusts push it forward). Your aim stays where you aim.
binosmovement.configuration.cameraIntens: How much of the body motion reaches the camera (0 to 100%).
binosmovement.configuration.shortSpins.t: For motion sickness: flips, spins and tumbles only tilt the camera.
binosmovement.configuration.firstPersonB: In first person you see your torso and legs when looking down.
